data.title: Safa Gate
data.about:
Welcome to Safa Gate, an exciting new project by DAMAC Properties in Safa Park, Dubai. Offering 1 & 2-bedroom apartments, along with 3 & 5-bedroom penthouses featuring private pools, Safa Gate combines luxury living with breathtaking views. Located in the heart of the Al Safa area, Safa Gate apartments provide seamless connections to major attractions. This remarkable real estate development redefines elegance with innovative architecture and a harmonious blend of natural elements.

Designed to cater to modern luxury living, Safa Gate boasts an array of world-class amenities, including a rooftop observation deck, infinity pools, an outdoor gym, a Gravity Gym, a yoga deck, and a private Eclipse Cinema. Residents can also enjoy an elegant cigar lounge, co-working pods, and multiple relaxation areas, creating an exclusive sanctuary in the heart of Dubai. With an attractive payment plan featuring 1% monthly installments over 48 months, owning a home in this prestigious development is now more accessible.

location_tile.title: Where Old Meets New: Embrace Dubai's Timeless Spirit at Al Safa
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Safa Gate at Al Safa Area by DAMAC Properties enjoys an ideal location in Dubai. Al Safa Area is perfectly positioned between Jumeirah and Sheikh Zayed Road. This once-quiet neighborhood, known for its low-rise villas and community charm, underwent a dramatic transformation with the opening of the Dubai Water Canal in 2016. The canal reshaped the area into a vibrant waterfront destination, connecting the historic Dubai Creek to the Arabian Gulf through Business Bay. This striking waterway not only infuses Al Safa with dynamic energy but also offers stunning views and a unique urban lifestyle.

  • Safa Park - Within Walking Distance
  • Burj Khalifa – 12 minutes
  • Dubai International Airport (DXB) – 10 minutes
  • Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) – 7 minutes
  • Dubai Harbour – 14 minutes
  • Palm Jumeirah – 14 minutes
